max_resolution.tooltip: Long side the frames are processed at (never upscaled). The geometry output has this size; depth and normals images are scaled back to the input size.

resolution_level.tooltip: MoGe detail level: 0 = fastest, 9 = most detail (more ViT tokens).

lock_camera.tooltip: One field of view and one metric scale for the whole clip: steadier depth from a fixed camera. Off: both estimated per frame, like single images. For a moving camera the per-frame scale can be steadier; turn this off and enter the logged FoV in fov_x_degrees to lock only the lens.

fov_x_degrees.tooltip: Horizontal field of view of the camera, if known. 0 = estimate it.

depth_style.tooltip: gray: near = white. turbo: near = red, far = blue. Normalized over the whole clip, so brightness does not pump.

normal_convention.tooltip: Normal-map green channel. OpenGL: green = up (Blender, Unity, Substance, glTF). DirectX: green = down (Unreal).

batch_size.tooltip: Frames per MoGe batch. Lowered automatically when it would not fit in the free VRAM.

output_tooltips: Points, metric depth, intrinsics, mask and normals at the processed resolution (OpenCV camera: X right, Y down, Z forward).

CorridorKey2DepthNormals.name: CorridorKey2DepthNormals
CorridorKey2DepthNormals.description: Metric depth, a camera-space point map and surface normals for every frame, from the MoGe-2 model already loaded inside CorridorKey 2.0 (no extra download). With lock_camera the field of view and metric scale are shared by the whole clip, which steadies depth from a fixed camera and lens. The geometry output works with ComfyUI's MoGe nodes (render, mesh, FoV).
